record.paper_title: Research Problems in Function Theory (New Edition)
record.original_question: Let H p be the space of functions f (z) = n=0 an z such that Z 2π p f (reiθ ) dθ remains bounded as r → 1. We define H ∞ to be the class of bounded functions in D. For 0 < p < 1 describe the coefficient multipliers from H p to H p . That is, for each such p describe the sequences λn such that X X λn an z n ∈ H p whenever an z n ∈ H p . (P. L. Duren)

evidence.quote: Let H p be the space of functions f (z) = n=0 an z such that Z 2π p f (reiθ ) dθ remains bounded as r → 1. We define H ∞ to be the class of bounded functions in D.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\mathbb{D}=\{z\in\mathbb{C}:|z|<1\}$ denote the open unit disc. For $0<p<\infty$, let $H^p$ denote the Hardy space of analytic functions $f(z)=\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}a_n z^n$ on $\mathbb{D}$ such that
$$\|f\|_{H^p}^p:=\sup_{0<r<1}\int_0^{2\pi}\bigl|f(re^{i\theta})\bigr|^p\,d\theta<\infty,$$
and let $H^\infty$ denote the space of bounded analytic functions on $\mathbb{D}$. A complex sequence $(\lambda_n)_{n\ge 0}$ is called a coefficient multiplier from $H^p$ to $H^p$ if for every $f(z)=\sum_{n=0}^\infty a_n z^n\in H^p$ the series
$$\sum_{n=0}^{\infty}\lambda_n a_n z^n$$
also represents a function in $H^p$.

For each fixed $p$ with $0<p<1$, give an explicit characterization (i.e., necessary and sufficient conditions) of the sequences $(\lambda_n)_{n\ge 0}$ that are coefficient multipliers from $H^p$ to $H^p$.
artifact.status_search_result: Duren and Shields (1970) and subsequent authors characterized the coefficient multipliers from $H^p$ (with $0<p<1$) into $\ell^q$ and into $H^q$ for $1\le q\le\infty$, showing these coincide with multipliers of the larger containing space $B^p$. However, the diagonal case $H^p\to H^p$ for $0<p<1$ is not covered by these results, and no explicit characterization appears in the literature found; the problem appears to remain open.

status_evidence.title: Coefficient multipliers of H^p and B^p spaces (Duren–Shields)
status_evidence.snippet: Characterizes coefficient multipliers of H^p (0<p<1) into l^q (p≤q≤∞) and into H^q (1≤q≤∞), but not into H^p itself.
status_evidence.claim: Known results characterize multipliers of H^p (0<p<1) into H^q only for q≥1; the H^p→H^p case is not addressed.

status_evidence.title: Multipliers on Spaces of Analytic Functions (O. Blasco)
status_evidence.snippet: Survey of multiplier results on spaces of analytic functions, with emphasis on H^p for p<1 leaving the H^p→H^p case unresolved.
status_evidence.claim: Surveys do not provide an explicit characterization of H^p→H^p multipliers for 0<p<1.
